_about: Tamil Nadu gold-standard evaluation set. EVALUATION ONLY — these drawings must never be used to train, tune thresholds or write drawing-specific rules. Each case states what its ground truth is and who/what verified it. Classes with no case are listed as empty, not filled with synthetic data.

aparna-block-a-refuge.building_type: multi-unit residential tower (refuge floor), rendered marketing plan, raster 6000x6000
aparna-block-a-refuge.verified_by: values printed on the drawing itself (area-statement table); not verified by an engineer
aparna-block-a-refuge.notes: No door / window schedule and no BOQ on the sheet → door / window counts and cost cannot be scored against ground truth.

tn-govt-small-buildings.drawing: ml/test_drawings/tamilnadu/*.pdf (27 sheets: anganwadi, VAO office, ration shop, PHC-type buildings, kitchen shed …)
tn-govt-small-buildings.building_type: small Tamil Nadu Government buildings (single / two storey), vector & scanned PDF sheets
tn-govt-small-buildings.source: public Tamil Nadu Government type-design drawings
tn-govt-small-buildings.verified_by: plinth-area notes and view titles printed on the sheets
tn-govt-small-buildings.expected_elements: sheet view (plan / elevation / section) per sheet
tn-govt-small-buildings.expected_quantities: plinth area where a plinth-area note is printed (16 sheets)
